# E0505: a value in the data matches none of the alternatives the schema allows

A value in the data matches none of the alternatives of a disjunction in the
schema. CUE reports one reason per alternative; each is a note, so the author
sees why every alternative was rejected.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				size: int | "large"
			}
		}
	}
}
```

`data.json`:

```json
{
	"size": true
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0505]: size in the data matches none of the alternatives schema 0.0 allows
 --> data.json:2:10
  |
2 |     "size": true
  |             ^^^^
  |             ---- size: conflicting values true and "large" (mismatched types bool and string)
  |             ---- size: conflicting values true and int (mismatched types bool and int)
  |
 ::: lineage.cue:6:11
  |
6 |                 size: int | "large"
  |                       --- the alternatives are declared here
  |
  = detail: size: 2 errors in empty disjunction:
```
